text:
linda.m: Heads-up — CobaltHealth onboarding: console shows an API key but their calls get 403 project_not_bound. Customer blocked on first integration.

sam.k: can you paste the tenant id + the exact curl you're running?

linda.m: tenant: tid-555
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H \"Authorization: Bearer KEY123\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\"

Response headers + body:
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: r-01a
x-project-id: proj-789

{\"error\":\"project_not_bound\",\"message\":\"API key not bound to project: expected proj-123\"}

sam.k: hmm x-project-id is proj-789 but the onboarding doc says the project should be proj-123. Did the console show proj-789 when you inspected the key?

linda.m: console shows the key under CobaltHealth -> Projects -> proj-123, but the key detail page shows KeyID: KEY123 and metadata project_id=proj-789 (UI/DB mismatch?)

onboard-bot: Provisioner: created api_key KEY123 for tenant tid-555 at 2025-11-18T14:22:05Z (provisioner v1.4.2)

ryan.infra: possible race during OIDC claim binding — provisioner may have reapplied a stale claim. Quick check: run the repair dry-run:

./tools/key-repair --key KEY123 --target-project proj-123 --dry-run

or SQL (if support has DB role):
-- dry-run select
SELECT key, project_id, tenant_id FROM api_keys WHERE key = 'KEY123';

If you confirm, we can run the actual repair:
UPDATE api_keys SET project_id='proj-123', updated_at = now() WHERE key='KEY123';

sam.k: @marcus (eng-platform) any objections to running the update? want to avoid creating duplicate claims.

marcus: go ahead. run the repair script (not raw SQL) so hooks fire. then sync claims + emit audit log. also open a follow-up to add idempotency in the provisioner.

linda.m: running repair now (running in prod):
./tools/key-repair --key KEY123 --target-project proj-123

linda.m: repair exited 0 — rechecked:
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H \"Authorization: Bearer KEY123\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\"

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
{\"id\":\"resp-01\",\"output\":\"...\"}

linda.m: customer confirms integration works. they were on a tight timeline, so closing the loop.

sam.k: awesome. can you paste the provisioner logs around 14:22? want to correlate.

linda.m: pasted logs to the incident ticket and created task INF-4312: add idempotency + alert on claim mismatch. also added a short blameless note for eng-platform.

marcus: thanks team. we'll follow up with a short postmortem and patch the provisioner. :thumbsup:

linda.m: closing thread — customer unblocked, will monitor for similar cases and surface alerts. :white_check_mark:
